notes.title: Demo Hot Fix 1.1
notes.content:
Hi there fellow Fleet Commanders!


Thank you so much to everyone who tried out the demo!

I've listened to your feedback and made some changes, I hope you like them!



Changelog:

The AI difficulty in the first levels has been better balanced.

The AI now handles deadlock situations more effectively.

Added a VSync option to the settings menu.

Added frame rate limit options for both the menu and in-game.

The typing effect in dialogue boxes is now faster.

Minor GUI fixes.



Thank you for your feedback.
